Painting Work Order.Interior Work: Repaint three bedrooms and home office (approx. 980 sq ft). Repair nail pops, sand rough patches, caulk gaps at trim, spot-prime stained areas, and apply two coats of washable matte on walls and satin on trim and doors. Remove and reinstall outlet/switch covers; minor ceiling edge touch-ups included.
Painting Work Order.Exterior Work: Refinish garage door, window frames, and front porch rails (approx. 650 sq ft). Pressure wash all surfaces, scrape and spot-prime bare wood, treat oxidation on metal hardware, and apply two coats of exterior urethane-acrylic paint. Fence panels along side yard to be stained per specification.
Painting Work Order.Materials: Low-VOC interior matte and satin paints, stain-blocking primer, exterior urethane-acrylic, bonding primer, wood filler, elastomeric caulk, spackle, sandpaper (120–220 grit), masking film, tape, drop cloths, brushes, roller covers, sprayer rental, deck/fence stain, rust converter, PPE.
Painting Work Order.Required: Access to water and 120V power on site, clear driveway/garage access for equipment, HOA or client approval of color selections prior to start, city permit for exterior work if required, compliance with lead-safe practices where applicable.
Painting Work Order.Estimate:: USD 5,320.00 (includes labor, materials, surface preparation, and standard masking; excludes major carpentry, hazardous-material abatement, and any permit or inspection fees).
